I'll start by reading `TASK.md` and `brief.md` in full, then follow the brief exactly—Section 0 overrides everything else.Section 0 requires the T8d and T9d decisions, their Sol reviews, the T8b method, and the listed proof scripts before any harness work. I'll read those next.The reviews name the same gaps the harness has to close. Next I’ll read the T8d and T9d scripts those proofs actually ran.The reviews failed on runner-armed writes, missing per-edge checks, and incomplete identity and import records. I’ll build those into the harness, then re-run the proofs within the six-process limit.The hook, table, and checker are in `work/harness`. Next I’ll make writer arming, per-edge checks, and the identity seal structural, then unit-test them before any emulator run.The identity run died in the candidate: the getter hook wrapped `h.finish` again on every call until the stack overflowed. K1e and K2 had already passed. I’ll put the fix in a new hook file and rerun.The identity table sealed, then the proof stopped: the candidate AF-ON commit asks for a K1e row the identity pass never stored. That was the sixth emulator process, so the display runs did not start. I’ll record that and write the manifest from the inventory.The identity pass sealed, and the proof then stopped on the first commit. Display did not run. `work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` are in place.

`identity-t11-v6` ended `ok:true`. The hook armed the stock writer itself when the owner went from 0 to 2, the writer ran 3 times, zone press and release including custom matched the K1e records, and the pose change after the non-reset normal edit did not copy the saved position into a different live cell. That table was sealed before the proof sessions started.

The proof refused `candidate-af-down`. That step expects a sealed row `k1e:ke-s1-down`, and the K1e step of that name is not marked as a commit, so the identity pass never stored the screen. The same gap is in the table for `k1e:ke-p-s1-down`. This was the sixth emulator process, so the display jobs were not started.

`work/harness.md` says how a later task uses the gate, the inventory, the seal, and `afon_hooks_v5.mjs`. The manifest seal is `work/out/evidence-manifest.seal.json`.The six emulator runs all exited with an error. The last one sealed the identity table (`identity-t11-v6`, `ok:true`), then the proof stopped at `candidate-af-down` because the sealed table has no `k1e:ke-s1-down` row. Display did not run.

`work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` record that outcome. The manifest seal is `work/out/evidence-manifest.seal.json`.
